owner_decision: Build the local phone-native version first with no required server; expand to AWS later with an approximate USD 35/month planning target excluding ParDay AI-provider charges. Preserve D-versus-AWS comparison for the later extension; no comparative winner measured.
scope: One native acquisition interface and job contract; implement and validate D first. A later comparison does not commit to shipping both modes or gate the first local release.

comparison_classification.same_extractor_version_and_settings: Can help isolate execution-location effects under declared conditions.
comparison_classification.different_extractors_or_encoders: Compare complete implementations; do not attribute all differences to location.
comparison_classification.scope_intersection: Same actual source, rendition and output target; unavailable extra coverage reported separately.
comparison_classification.unofficial_candidates: Included; official API is not a universal technical prerequisite.

stages.evidence: Controlled fixture correctness and existing DLA cases; licence/deployment eligibility separated from technical status.
stages.cloud_source_path_gate: Validate permitted actual source resolution/acquisition from declared AWS region/runtime before meaningful performance comparison; no data-center access assumed.
stages.phase_applicability: D correctness applies to local build; AWS source-path variant deferred until expansion.

proposed_sampling.expand_rule: Only if remaining uncertainty can alter selection.

stages.tail_estimate_rule: Do not market stable p95/tail behavior from the small initial sample.
stages.phase_applicability: Paired D/AWS comparison deferred; preserve local fixtures and rerun current D cases at expansion.

stages.prerequisite: Phase-specific: local D requires viable C0 correctness/source evidence; the deferred paired D/AWS comparison additionally requires usable C1 candidates.
stages.baseline: Same prepared local set with acquisition disabled.
stages.certification: Relevant shared warm-soak/audio gates remain required; short comparison is not certification.
stages.phase_applicability: D local audio coexistence required for implemented workload; paired AWS variant deferred.

stages.offline_invariant: Prepared local set remains independent of AWS and any optional home-lab service.
stages.phase_applicability: Local lifecycle/recovery required; server and cloud-specific variants deferred.

stages.purpose: Owner setup and maintenance; independent operator validation conditional on community-reproducibility claims
stages.operator_applicability: Owner clean setup for personal comparison; another operator only for optional community-reproducibility validation
stages.phase_applicability: Phone build/setup/maintenance required; cloud setup, cost and teardown variants deferred.

timing.clock_rule: Never subtract unsynchronized wall clocks across hosts.
timing.parallel_span_rule: Spans may overlap; their sum need not equal end-to-end time.

power_measurement_policy.metric_availability: Record supported sensors/counters and sampling constraints; unavailable is not zero.
power_measurement_policy.scope: Device-level observations are not automatically app-attributed energy.
power_measurement_policy.baseline: Paired idle/local-set baseline at comparable brightness, charge, charging state and environment.
power_measurement_policy.reporting: Separate phone and server/network costs; battery percentage alone is a coarse proxy.
power_measurement_policy.thermal: Observe supported status/headroom, respecting Android sampling guidance; invalid readings remain unavailable.

decision_rule: The local implementation sequence is selected, but no measured comparative winner is claimed. Pass mandatory gates for each implemented path; during later AWS evaluation present measured tradeoffs against local independence and the approximate USD 35/month target. No arbitrary aggregate score or automatic backend choice.

delivery_sequence.promotion_condition: Usable local version plus a concrete processing, maintenance or source-path benefit to evaluate; costed current AWS trial selected separately.
